# Input group

An input with addons inside its border: icons, text, buttons.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A value with a unit, or a search with a clear button. Not for controls that are separate fields.

- **Use it when:** A search with an icon and a clear button, a value with a unit or currency.
- **Not when:** Controls that are separate fields (lay them out with field).

Instead:

- [Input](./input.md): A plain field.

## Why it works this way

Input group looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Input group, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What do icons do?</b><code>iconography.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Those and decoration</div><p>Icons also decorate campaign pages.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: The search icon before the text.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: ghost</code> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Empty: icon</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Two</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the smallest target?</b><code>accessibility.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Touch size</div><p>Visitors come from social posts on phones.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: The unit after the value, or the clear button with a word: hover hints never show on phones.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: default</code> <code>Button: compact</code> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Item: default</code> <code>Item: sm</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: sm</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Those and pressed</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Images and campaigns</div><p>Images, campaigns and short punchy copy.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: Copy is short and sign-up is the one action, so fields stay one line.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Copy is short and sign-up is the one action, so fields stay one line.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: info</code> <code>Empty: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 10 answers that follow from it: <b>One idea at a time</b>, <b>Browse and explore</b>, <b>Regular</b>, and 7 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How often do people repeat actions?</b><code>tasks.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Rarely</div><p>One action: sign up.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: Copy is short and sign-up is the one action, so fields stay one line.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Copy is short and sign-up is the one action, so fields stay one line.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: default</code> <code>Toggle: lg</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Three</b>, <b>Only what today's screens use</b>.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Addon buttons have names; icons that only decorate are hidden from screen readers. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add input-group
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
